data.one_liner: A customizable Hijri and Gregorian date picker widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a date picker widget and dialog supporting both Hijri and normal calendars with extensive customization options for themes, colors, and layouts.
use_when: You need to allow users to select Hijri dates in your Flutter application.
You want a date picker that supports both Gregorian and Hijri calendar types with customizable UI.
avoid_when: You only need a standard Gregorian date picker and want to rely solely on built-in Flutter packages.
You require complex non-calendar form builders.
strengths: Supports both Hijri and normal (Gregorian) date selection.
Highly customizable with options for colors, text direction, and headers.
Can be used as a simple dialog, a full dialog, or directly embedded as a widget.
weaknesses: Requires an external dependency (jhijri) for Hijri converter functionality.
Documentation is limited primarily to basic README snippets.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding jhijri converter to pubspec.yaml if using Hijri dates in JDateModel.
